latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the coros-skill for retrieving and analyzing COROS running data.

- Supports automatic login with token/cookie caching.
- Fetches dashboard data: training status, recent activities, and weekly summary.
- Retrieves activity list and detailed training records, including lap, weather, and performance metrics.
- Allows viewing and previewing training schedules and goals.
- Simple chat trigger phrases and command line usage available.
